source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 20 (PDF 155-168), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 20 (Biotechnology) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 In scientific terms, biotechnology is defined as the use of organisms, biological processes or systems to:
(Scientific taur par biotechnology ki definition hai: organisms, biological processes ya systems ka istemal taa ke:)

options.text: aise products banein jo insani zindagi aur mahol behtar karein
khatam shuda species ke fossils parhe jayein

blocks.explanation: Biotechnology organisms, biological processes ya systems ka istemal hai taa ke aise products banein jo insani zindagi aur mahol behtar karein (20.1).

book_ref.quote: it is defined as the use of organisms, biological processes, or systems to make products

blocks.prompt:
2 Traditional biotechnology has been used for thousands of years in the form of:
(Riwayati biotechnology hazaron saal se kis shakal mein istemal ho rahi hai?)

options.text: DNA copy karne ke liye PCR
genes muntaqil karne ke liye gene gun
bread, cheese aur beer ke liye fermentation

blocks.explanation: Riwayati biotechnology fermentation (khameer) se bread, cheese aur beer jaise khane banati rahi (20.1).

book_ref.quote: Traditional biotechnology has been used for thousands of years in the form of fermentation

blocks.prompt:
3 Modern biotechnology emerged in the 20th century after the discovery of:
(Jadeed biotechnology 20vi sadi mein kis daryaft ke baad saamne aayi?)

options.text: DNA ki structure aur advanced molecular techniques

blocks.explanation: Jadeed biotechnology DNA ki structure aur advanced molecular techniques ki daryaft ke baad aayi (20.1).

book_ref.quote: Modern biotechnology emerged in the 20th century

blocks.prompt:
4 Genetic engineering is defined as:
(Genetic engineering ki definition kya hai?)

options.text: organism ke DNA mein tabdeeli taa ke traits ya salahiyatein badlein

blocks.explanation: Genetic engineering kisi organism ke DNA mein tabdeeli hai taa ke us ki khususiyaat (traits) ya salahiyatein badlein, genes daal kar, nikaal kar ya badal kar (20.1).

book_ref.quote: Genetic engineering is defined as the alteration of an organism

blocks.prompt:
5 Of the two basic technologies of genetic engineering, rapidly amplifying a tiny segment of DNA into a large quantity is:
(Genetic engineering ki do buniyadi technologies mein se DNA ke chhote tukre ko tezi se bari miqdar mein barhana kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: PCR DNA ke chhote tukre ko tezi se barhata hai; recombinant DNA technology aik organism ka DNA kaat kar doosre mein jodti hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: Rapidly amplifying a tiny segment of DNA into a large quantity.

blocks.prompt:
6 Recombinant DNA technology means:
(Recombinant DNA technology ka kya matlab hai?)

options.text: garam aur thanda kar ke DNA copy karna
plant cell ki cell wall hatana
mukhtalif zarai ka DNA kaat kar, jod kar aik hybrid molecule banana

blocks.explanation: Recombinant DNA technology mukhtalif zarai ke DNA ko kaat kar, jod kar aik hybrid molecule banana hai, phir use host mein dalna (20.2).

book_ref.quote: cutting, splicing, and combining DNA molecules from different sources into a single hybrid molecule

blocks.text: 20.2.1 Tools used in Recombinant DNA Technology

blocks.prompt:
7 Making the gene of interest from its mRNA requires the enzyme:
(Gene of interest ko us ke mRNA se banane ke liye kaun sa enzyme chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Gene of interest us ke mRNA ki reverse transcription se reverse transcriptase enzyme ke zariye banaya ja sakta hai (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Synthesis by doing reverse transcription of its mRNA by using reverse transcriptase enzymes.

blocks.prompt:
8 Which enzymes are called molecular scissors?
(Kaun se enzymes molecular scissors (salmati qainchi) kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Restriction endonucleases DNA mein makhsoos nucleotide sequences kaat'te hain, is liye molecular scissors kehlate hain (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: They are also called molecular scissors.

blocks.prompt:
9 The specific nucleotide sequence recognised by a restriction endonuclease is called the:
(Restriction endonuclease jis makhsoos nucleotide sequence ko pehchanta hai, use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har restriction endonuclease aik makhsoos sequence pehchanta hai jise restriction site ya recognition region kehte hain (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Such a sequence of nucleotides is called restriction site or recognition region.

blocks.prompt:
10 Restriction sites have palindromic sequences of:
(Restriction sites ki palindromic sequences kitne nucleotides ki hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Restriction sites ki palindromic sequences chaar se aath nucleotides ki hoti hain (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The restriction sites have palindromic sequences of four to eight nucleotides.

blocks.prompt:
11 At a palindromic restriction site, the two DNA strands:
(Palindromic restriction site par DNA ke dono strands ki kya khasiyat hai?)

options.text: aik jaisi sequence mukhalif simton mein

blocks.explanation: Restriction site par dono strands ki nucleotide sequence aik jaisi hoti hai magar mukhalif simton mein chalti hai (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: the two strands of the DNA have the same nucleotide sequence running in opposite directions

blocks.prompt:
12 After cleavage by a restriction endonuclease, the DNA fragments have:
(Restriction endonuclease ke kaatne ke baad DNA tukron ke sire kaise hote hain?)

options.text: aapas mein complementary chhote single-stranded sticky sire

blocks.explanation: Dono tukron ke chand nucleotides lambe single-stranded sire hote hain jo sticky (chipakne wale), yani aapas mein complementary hote hain (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: both DNA fragments have single-stranded ends (a few nucleotides long) that are sticky

blocks.prompt:
13 Restriction endonucleases are valuable in genetic engineering because DNA fragments produced by the same enzyme:
(Restriction endonucleases genetic engineering mein qeemti kyun hain? Kyunke aik hi enzyme se bane DNA tukre:)

options.text: garmi se tabah ho jaate hain
aapas mein jode ja sakte hain
plate par neele ho jaate hain

blocks.explanation: Aik hi restriction endonuclease se bane koi bhi do DNA tukre aapas mein jode ja sakte hain (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: any two DNA fragments produced by the same restriction endonuclease can be joined together

blocks.prompt:
14 Molecules that carry the gene of interest into host cells are called:
(Woh molecules jo gene of interest ko host cells tak le jaate hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Vectors (molecular carriers) gene of interest ko host cells mein dakhil karne ke liye istemal hote hain (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Special molecules called vectors (or molecular carrier) are used for the introduction

blocks.prompt:
15 Cosmids are:
(Cosmids kya hain?)

options.text: woh plasmids jin mein bacteriophage DNA ka cos sequence ho
garmi bardasht karne wali DNA polymerases

blocks.explanation: Cosmids woh plasmids hain jin mein bacteriophage DNA ka chhota hissa, cos sequence, hota hai (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: plasmids that contain a small region of bacteriophage DNA called the cos sequence

blocks.prompt:
16 Phage lambda and bacteriophage P1 are used in recombinant DNA technology as:
(Phage lambda aur bacteriophage P1 recombinant DNA technology mein kis taur par istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Phage lambda aur bacteriophage P1 jaise bacteriophages vectors hain, aam istemal hone wale bacterial plasmids ke ilawa (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Bacteriophages (e.g., phage lambda, bacteriophage P1)

blocks.prompt:
17 Animal viruses such as the human cold virus serve as vectors to carry genes into:
(Human cold virus jaise animal viruses genes ko kin cells mein le jaane ke liye vectors hain?)
blocks.explanation: Animal viruses (maslan human cold virus) genes ko bandar aur insani cells mein le jaane ke liye vectors hain (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Animal viruses (e.g., human cold virus) also serve as vectors

blocks.prompt:
18 DNA ligase joins two DNA fragments by forming:
(DNA ligase do DNA tukron ko kis cheez se jodta hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNA ligase, yani molecular glue, do saath wale nucleotides ke darmiyan phosphodiester linkage banata hai (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: It forms the phosphodiester linkage between two adjacent nucleotides.

blocks.prompt:
19 The selection of a suitable expression system depends upon the:
(Munasib expression system ka intikhab kis par munhasir hai?)

options.text: rDNA banane wale vector ki qisam

blocks.explanation: Expression system ka intikhab rDNA banane mein istemal hone wale vector ki qisam par munhasir hai (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: The selection of suitable expression system depends upon the type of vector used to make rDNA.

blocks.prompt:
20 Bacterial cells are used as an expression system because of their:
(Bacterial cells expression system ke taur par kyun istemal hote hain?)

options.text: kam generation time aur saada genetic system

blocks.explanation: Bacteria ki nasal ka kam waqt (short generation time) aur saada genetic system unhein achha expression system banata hai (20.2.1).

book_ref.quote: because of their short generation time and simple genetic system

blocks.prompt:
21 To produce compatible sticky ends on the gene of interest and the vector, both DNAs are cut with:
(Gene of interest aur vector par milte julte sticky ends banane ke liye dono DNA kis se kaate jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Source DNA aur vector DNA aik hi endonuclease se kaate jaate hain, is liye milte julte sticky ends bante hain (20.2.2).

book_ref.quote: So, compatible sticky ends are produced at the gene of interest and the cleaved vector.

blocks.prompt:
22 To produce recombinant DNA, the cleaved vector and the gene of interest are incubated together in the presence of:
(Recombinant DNA banane ke liye kate hue vector aur gene of interest ko kis ki mojoodgi mein saath rakha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kata hua vector aur gene of interest DNA ligase ke saath rakhe jaate hain jo phosphodiester linkages se unhein jodta hai (20.2.2).

book_ref.quote: the cleaved vector and the gene of interest are incubated together in the presence of DNA ligase

blocks.prompt:
23 The plasmid gene shown in Figure 20.3 (labelled 'Antibody resistance gene' in print) is actually a gene for:
(Figure 20.3 mein plasmid ka gene (chhapai mein 'Antibody resistance gene') asal mein kis cheez ka gene hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh antibiotic resistance ka gene hai, jo baad mein plasmid lene wale bacteria chunne ke kaam aata hai (20.2.2, book correction).

book_ref.quote: it is an antibiotic resistance gene, as drawn above

blocks.prompt:
24 For cloning of the recombinant vector, the recombinant DNA and the expression system are:
(Recombinant vector ki cloning ke liye recombinant DNA aur expression system ke saath kya kiya jata hai?)

options.text: saath 98°C tak garam kiye jaate hain
aik hi medium mein rakhe jaate hain
sone ke zarron se dhanpe jaate hain
radioactive probe se milaye jaate hain

blocks.explanation: Recombinant DNA aur expression system (aam taur par bacteria) aik hi medium mein rakhe jaate hain; bacteria rDNA le lete hain (20.2.2).

book_ref.quote: The recombinant DNA (vector) and the expression system (usually bacteria) are incubated in the same medium.

blocks.prompt:
25 When bacteria are grown on a medium containing ampicillin after transformation, the cells that survive are those that:
(Transformation ke baad ampicillin wale medium par kaun se bacteria zinda rehte hain?)

options.text: jin mein sirf kaam karta lacZ' gene ho
jin ki cell wall khatam ho
jin mein koi plasmid na ho

blocks.explanation: Plasmid mein antibiotic resistance gene hota hai; sirf woh cells jo plasmid le lein antibiotic wale medium par zinda rehte hain (20.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Only cells that took up a plasmid will survive and grow.

blocks.prompt:
26 In blue-white screening, the desired recombinant clones are:
(Blue-white screening mein matloob recombinant clones kis rang ke hote hain?)

options.text: neele, kyunke lacZ' kaam karta rehta hai
safaid, kyunke un mein plasmid nahi
neele, kyunke unhon ne probe liya
safaid, kyunke dakhil gene lacZ' ko tor deta hai

blocks.explanation: Gene of interest dakhil ho to lacZ' toot jata hai, is liye recombinant clones safaid rehte hain; ghair-recombinant plasmid mein lacZ' kaam karta hai aur colony neeli hoti hai (20.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Therefore, the desired recombinant clones will remain white.

blocks.prompt:
27 In blue-white screening, the blue colour is produced by:
(Blue-white screening mein neela rang kis se paida hota hai?)

options.text: lacZ' gene ka enzyme jo khaas sugar par amal kare

blocks.explanation: lacZ' gene aik enzyme banata hai jo aik khaas sugar ko metabolize kar ke neela kar deta hai (20.2.2).

book_ref.quote: The lacZ' gene produces an enzyme which metabolizes a specific sugar and turns it blue.

blocks.prompt:
28 In DNA hybridization screening, the radioactive probe is:
(DNA hybridization screening mein radioactive probe kya hai?)

options.text: gene of interest ka complementary DNA strand

blocks.explanation: Probe aik radioactive DNA strand hai jo gene of interest ka complementary hai; yeh sirf us gene wali colonies se chipakta hai (20.2.2).

book_ref.quote: To confirm the presence of gene of interest, a radioactive probe is used.

blocks.prompt:
29 The colonies to which the probe has hybridized are located on the master plate by:
(Probe jin colonies se chipak gaya, unhein master plate par kaise dhoonda jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Autoradiography (photographic film) master plate par gene of interest wali colonies dhoondti hai (20.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Auto-radiography (photographic film) is used to locate these specific colonies on the master plate.

blocks.prompt:
30 PCR was developed in 1983 by:
(PCR 1983 mein kis ne banaya?)
blocks.explanation: Kary Mullis ne 1983 mein PCR banaya aur 1993 mein Chemistry ka Nobel Prize jeeta (20.3).

book_ref.quote: Kary Mullis developed PCR in 1983.

blocks.prompt:
31 The developer of PCR won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in:
(PCR banane wale ne Chemistry ka Nobel Prize kab jeeta?)
blocks.explanation: PCR 1983 mein bana; Kary Mullis ne 1993 mein Chemistry ka Nobel Prize jeeta (20.3).

book_ref.quote: He won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1993.

blocks.prompt:
32 The technique is called polymerase chain reaction because:
(Is technique ko polymerase chain reaction kyun kehte hain?)

options.text: ligase DNA ki zanjeer jodta hai
DNA polymerase DNA ke tukre ko baar baar copy karta hai

blocks.explanation: DNA polymerase DNA ke aik tukre ko baar baar copy karta hai aur kai copies banti hain; is liye yeh naam hai (20.3).

book_ref.quote: That’s why, the technique is known as polymerase chain reaction (PCR).

blocks.prompt:
33 A primer used in PCR is a sequence of:
(PCR mein istemal hone wala primer kitne nucleotides ki sequence hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primer 20 se 30 nucleotides ki sequence hai jo DNA tukre mein zyada miqdar mein milaya jata hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: First, an excessive amount of primer (a sequence of 20 to 30 nucleotides) is mixed with the DNA fragment

blocks.prompt:
34 In the denaturation step of PCR, the mixture of primers and DNA is heated to about:
(PCR ke denaturation qadam mein primers aur DNA ka mixture taqreeban kitna garam kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Denaturation mein mixture taqreeban 98°C tak garam hota hai aur double-stranded DNA single strands mein toot jata hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: This mixture of primers and DNA is heated to about 98°C.

blocks.prompt:
35 After denaturation in PCR, each single strand of DNA acts as:
(PCR mein denaturation ke baad har single DNA strand kya kaam karta hai?)

options.text: in vitro DNA synthesis ke liye template

blocks.explanation: Har single-stranded DNA in vitro (lab mein) DNA synthesis ke liye template (saancha) ban sakta hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Each single stranded DNA can act as the template for the in vitro DNA synthesis.

blocks.prompt:
36 During annealing in PCR, the solution is cooled to about 60°C so that:
(PCR mein annealing ke dauran solution taqreeban 60°C tak thanda kyun kiya jata hai?)

options.text: primers single-stranded DNA ke complementary hisson se jud jayein

blocks.explanation: Taqreeban 60°C par thanda hone se forward aur backward primers single strands ke complementary hisson se jud jaate hain (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The solution is allowed to cool to about 60°C.

blocks.prompt:
37 During extension of primer, Taq polymerase adds new nucleotides to the primer's:
(Primer ki extension mein Taq polymerase naye nucleotides primer ke kis sire par jodta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taq polymerase naye nucleotides primer ke 3' sire par jodta aur baqi tukra copy karta hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The Taq polymerase adds new nucleotides to the 3

blocks.prompt:
38 At the end of the first PCR cycle, the number of copies of the original DNA fragment is:
(PCR ke pehle cycle ke aakhir mein asal DNA tukre ki kitni copies hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dono strands replicate hote hain, is liye ab asal DNA tukre ki do copies hain (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Because both DNA strands are replicated, there are now two copies of the original DNA fragment.

blocks.prompt:
39 More polymerase need not be added in each new PCR cycle because:
(PCR ke har naye cycle mein mazeed polymerase kyun nahi dalna parta?)

options.text: garmi is enzyme ko nuqsan nahi deti
aik cycle ke baad reaction ruk jata hai

blocks.explanation: Garmi Taq polymerase ko nuqsan nahi deti, is liye qadam 1 se 3 dohrate waqt mazeed polymerase nahi dala jata (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: It is not necessary to add any more polymerase, as the heating does not harm this enzyme.

blocks.prompt:
40 After 20 cycles of PCR, a single fragment of DNA produces:
(PCR ke 20 cycles ke baad aik DNA tukra kitni copies banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har cycle DNA dugna karta hai; 20 cycles ke baad aik tukre se das lakh se zyada copies banti hain (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: After 20 cycles, a single fragment of DNA produces more than one million copies.

blocks.prompt:
41 Starting from one DNA fragment, how many copies are present after three PCR cycles?
(Aik DNA tukre se shuru kar ke teen PCR cycles ke baad kitni copies hongi?)
blocks.explanation: Har cycle molecules dugne karta hai: teen cycles ke baad 1 → 2 → 4 → 8 (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Steps 1 to 3 are repeated and the two copies become four.

blocks.prompt:
42 After the third PCR cycle, how many of the eight copies carry an original (parent) strand?
(Teesre PCR cycle ke baad aath copies mein se kitni mein asal (parent) strand hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf do parent strands hain, is liye aath mein se sirf do copies mein parent strand hai (20.3.1, Figure 20.6 ki book correction).

book_ref.quote: There are only two parent strands, so only two of the eight copies carry one

blocks.prompt:
43 Taq polymerase is obtained from Thermus aquaticus, a bacterium found in:
(Taq polymerase Thermus aquaticus se hasil hota hai, jo bacterium kahan paya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taq polymerase Thermus aquaticus se nikala jata hai jo garam chashmon ka bacterium hai; yeh ubalne ke qareeb temperature par bhi kaam karta hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The Taq polymerase is a temperature-tolerant enzyme isolated from Thermus aquaticus

blocks.prompt:
44 A genomic library, which PCR is also used to build, is:
(Genomic library, jise banane mein PCR bhi istemal hota hai, kya hai?)

options.text: aik organism ke kul DNA ka majmua
insulin banane wale bacteria ki culture

blocks.explanation: Genomic library aik organism ke kul DNA ka majmua hai, jo aam taur par DNA sequencing ke liye istemal hota hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: PCR is also used to build genomic library.

blocks.prompt:
45 In criminal investigations, PCR is used to prepare DNA fingerprints from:
(Jurm ki tehqeeq mein PCR se DNA fingerprints kis se tayyar kiye jaate hain?)

options.text: sookhe khoon ke chhote namoone ya aik baal ki jar ke cells
sirf taaza khoon ki bari miqdar

blocks.explanation: DNA fingerprints sookhe khoon ke chhote se namoone ya aik baal ki jar ke cells se tayyar hote hain (20.3).

book_ref.quote: are prepared from the cells in a tiny sample of dried blood or at the base of a single human hair

blocks.prompt:
46 Physicians detect genetic defects in very early embryos with PCR by:
(Doctors PCR se bohat ibtidai embryos mein genetic naqais kaise dhoondte hain?)

options.text: embryo ko ampicillin mein ugaa kar
chand jhare hue cells ka DNA barha kar

blocks.explanation: Woh chand jhare hue (sloughed-off) cells le kar un ka DNA barhate hain (20.3).

book_ref.quote: Physicians can detect genetic defects in very early embryos

blocks.prompt:
47 PCR can examine the DNA of extinct species as long as:
(PCR khatam shuda species ka DNA kab tak jaanch sakta hai?)

options.text: un ke DNA ki bohat thodi miqdar bhi saalim ho

blocks.explanation: PCR khatam shuda species ka DNA jaanch sakta hai jab tak un ke DNA ki bohat thodi miqdar bhi saalim ho (20.3).

book_ref.quote: PCR is also used to examine the DNA of extinct species

blocks.prompt:
48 Transgenic organisms are GMOs that have received DNA from:
(Transgenic organisms woh GMOs hain jinhein DNA kahan se mila ho?)
blocks.explanation: Transgenic organisms GMOs ka aik hissa hain jinhein kisi doosri, ghair-mutaliq species ka DNA mila ho (20.4).

book_ref.quote: Transgenic organisms are a specific subset of GMOs

blocks.prompt:
49 To produce a whole multicellular GMO, the gene is transferred into:
(Poora multicellular GMO banane ke liye gene kis mein muntaqil kiya jata hai?)

options.text: gamete ya gamete banane wala tissue

blocks.explanation: Poore multicellular GMO ke liye gene gamete ya gamete banane wale tissue mein dala jata hai; phir aise gametes milaye jaate hain (20.4).

book_ref.quote: To produce a whole multicellular GMO, the gene is transferred into a gamete or gamete-producing tissue.

blocks.prompt:
50 In electroporation, the pores created in the target cell close when:
(Electroporation mein target cell ke suraakh kab band hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Electroporation suraakh banata hai jin se gene andar jata hai; bijli ka current khatam hote hi suraakh band ho jaate hain (20.4).

book_ref.quote: Once the electrical current is discharged, the pores are closed.

blocks.prompt:
51 The method in which a fine needle directly injects the gene into the target cell nucleus is:
(Woh tareeqa jis mein bareek sui se gene seedha target cell ke nucleus mein dala jata hai:)
blocks.explanation: Microinjection mein bareek sui se gene seedha target cell ke nucleus mein dala jata hai (20.4).

book_ref.quote: a fine needle, or injection, is used to directly inject the gene into the target cell nucleus

blocks.prompt:
52 In biolistic transformation (gene gun), the DNA is:
(Biolistic transformation (gene gun) mein DNA ke saath kya kiya jata hai?)

options.text: bareek sui se dala jata hai
current ke suraakhon se andar jata hai
heavy metal ke khurdbeeni zarron par chadha kar cell mein maara jata hai

blocks.explanation: DNA heavy metal (aam taur par gold ya tungsten) ke khurdbeeni zarron par chadhaya jata hai jinhein gene gun cell mein maarti hai (20.4, book correction).

book_ref.quote: it is coated onto microscopic particles of a heavy metal (usually gold or tungsten)

blocks.prompt:
53 In the protoplast-mediated technique, the protoplast is a cell whose:
(Protoplast mediated technique mein protoplast kaisa cell hai?)

options.text: cell membrane aur cell wall dono hata di gayin
cell wall hata di gayi, cell membrane saalim
DNA par gold chadha diya gaya

blocks.explanation: Protoplast ki sirf cell wall hatayi jati hai; cell membrane saalim rehti hai aur DNA usi se andar jata hai (20.4, book correction).

book_ref.quote: A protoplast is a cell whose cell wall has been removed

blocks.prompt:
54 In chemical methods of gene transfer, the chemical–DNA complex enters the cytoplasm by:
(Gene transfer ke chemical methods mein chemical aur DNA ka complex cytoplasm mein kaise dakhil hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Naked DNA ko chemical agent se milaya jata hai; complex diffusion ya endocytosis se cytoplasm mein jata hai (20.4).

book_ref.quote: The chemical and DNA complex enters into the cell cytoplasm through diffusion or endocytosis.

blocks.prompt:
55 Which is used in virus-mediated gene transfer?
(Virus mediated gene transfer mein kaun sa istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Adenovirus, adeno-associated virus, HIV, lentivirus aur doosre retroviruses gene transfer ke liye istemal hote hain (20.4).

book_ref.quote: Adenovirus, Adeno-associated virus, HIV, lentivirus and other retroviruses are used for gene transfer.

blocks.prompt:
56 Transgenic bacteria are useful because they:
(Transgenic bacteria kyun mufeed hain?)

options.text: aik cell se naye paude banate hain
silk proteins wala doodh dete hain
dakhil ghair genes ke proteins bari miqdar mein banate hain

blocks.explanation: Transgenic bacteria dakhil kiye gaye ghair genes ke proteins bari miqdar mein banate hain (20.4.1).

book_ref.quote: Transgenic bacteria can synthesize large amounts of the proteins encoded by the inserted foreign genes.

blocks.prompt:
57 Human growth hormone produced by transgenic bacteria is used to treat:
(Transgenic bacteria se bana human growth hormone kis ke ilaj mein istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Human growth hormone dwarfism (bonapan) ka ilaj hai; insulin diabetes ka; interferon kuch cancers ka (20.4.1).

book_ref.quote: human growth hormone (to treat dwarfism), interferon (to treat some cancers)

blocks.prompt:
58 The food enzyme produced by transgenic bacteria that clots milk protein for cheese making is:
(Transgenic bacteria ka bana woh food enzyme jo cheese ke liye doodh ka protein jamata hai:)
blocks.explanation: Chymosin cheese ke liye doodh ka protein jamata hai; alpha-amylase starch ko sugars banata hai; pectin-esterase juice saaf karta hai (20.4.1).

book_ref.quote: chymosin (clots milk protein for cheese making)

blocks.prompt:
59 Which is an environmental use of transgenic bacteria?
(Transgenic bacteria ka mahol se mutaliq istemal kaun sa hai?)

options.text: peene ke paani mein arsenic dhoondna

blocks.explanation: Transgenic bacteria toxins tor'te, ore se copper nikaalte, mercury ki aaloodgi saaf karte aur peene ke paani mein arsenic dhoondte hain (20.4.1).

book_ref.quote: Leach copper from ore, clean up mercury pollution and detect arsenic in drinking water.

blocks.prompt:
60 Transgenic goats produce the human enzyme lysozyme in their milk to:
(Transgenic bakriyan apne doodh mein insani enzyme lysozyme kis liye banati hain?)

options.text: insanon mein dast wale bacteria se larna

blocks.explanation: Transgenic bakriyan doodh mein lysozyme banati hain taa ke insanon mein dast paida karne wale bacteria se lara ja sake (20.4.2).

book_ref.quote: Transgenic goats also produce human enzyme lysozyme in their milk

blocks.prompt:
61 Which is a feature of transgenic fish?
(Transgenic machhli ki khasiyat kaun si hai?)

options.text: insani maa ke doodh jaisa doodh

blocks.explanation: Transgenic machhli mein behtar growth, kam khurak, sardi bardasht mein izafa aur bimari ke khilaf mazbooti hai (20.4.2).

book_ref.quote: Transgenic fish show better growth, reduced food intake, increased cold tolerance, and disease resistance.

blocks.prompt:
62 The first human biological drug produced from a transgenic goat was:
(Transgenic bakri se banne wali pehli insani biological dawa kya thi?)

options.text: surgery ya wiladat mein khoon jamne ko kam karne wala anticoagulant

blocks.explanation: Transgenic bakri se pehli insani biological dawa aik anticoagulant thi jo surgery ya wiladat mein khoon jamne ka imkaan kam kare (20.4.2).

book_ref.quote: The first human biological drug produced from a transgenic goat was an anticoagulant

blocks.prompt:
63 Malaria-resistant mosquitoes have been developed by inserting a gene that:
(Malaria ke khilaf mazboot machhar kis gene ko daal kar banaye gaye hain?)

options.text: un mein Plasmodium ki nashonuma kam kare
un ke luaab mein lysozyme banaye

blocks.explanation: Malaria se mehfooz machharon mein aisa gene dala gaya jo un ke andar Plasmodium ki nashonuma kam karta hai (20.4.2).

book_ref.quote: by inserting a gene that reduces the development of Plasmodium in them

blocks.prompt:
64 Mice are the key model for investigating diseases because:
(Bimariyon ki tehqeeq ke liye choohe ahem model kyun hain?)

options.text: un ka genome mukammal parha ja chuka aur insanon jaisa hai
unhein genetically modify nahi kiya ja sakta

blocks.explanation: Choohe is liye istemal hote hain ke un ke genome ka mukammal tajziya ho chuka hai aur woh insanon se bohat milta hai (20.4.2).

book_ref.quote: Mice are the model for this purpose because there is complete analysis of its genome sequence

blocks.prompt:
65 Most research on inserting foreign genes in humans has focused on somatic cells because germline transformation:
(Insanon mein ghair genes daalne ki zyada tar tehqeeq somatic cells par kyun hai? Kyunke germline transformation:)

options.text: wirasati tabdeeli laati hai aur is mein khatraat aur akhlaqi masail hain
sirf bacteria mein kaam karti hai

blocks.explanation: Germline cells mein dale gaye genes wirasati tabdeeli laate hain; khatraat aur akhlaqi masail ki wajah se tehqeeq somatic cells par hai (20.4.2).

book_ref.quote: If genes are inserted in germline cells, it results in inheritable changes.

blocks.prompt:
66 A new plant can be grown from a single transgenic plant cell because many plant cells are:
(Aik transgenic plant cell se naya paudha kyun ug sakta hai? Kyunke bohat se plant cells:)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se plant cells totipotent hain: aik cell poora naya paudha bana sakta hai (20.4.3).

book_ref.quote: Many plant cells are totipotent, meaning that a single cell can form a new plant.

blocks.prompt:
67 Genes of Bacillus thuringiensis inserted in crops such as cotton make proteins that:
(Cotton jaisi faslon mein dale gaye Bacillus thuringiensis ke genes aise proteins banate hain jo:)

options.text: shehad ki makhiyon samait sab keeron ko maarein
nuqsandeh keeron ko maarein, mufeed keeron ko nahi

blocks.explanation: B. thuringiensis ke genes aise proteins banate hain jo nuqsandeh keeron ko maarte magar mufeed keeron ko nuqsan nahi dete (20.4.3).

book_ref.quote: These genes make proteins that kill insect pests but do not harm other useful insects.

blocks.prompt:
68 Glyphosate, against which many crops have been made resistant, is:
(Glyphosate, jis ke khilaf bohat si faslein mazboot banayi gayi hain, kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat si faslein glyphosate, aik herbicide (jari booti maar dawa), ke khilaf mazboot banayi gayi hain (20.4.3).

book_ref.quote: Many crops have been modified to be resistant against glyphosate (an herbicide).

blocks.prompt:
69 In transgenic rice, the genes for making beta-carotene (precursor of vitamin A) were taken from:
(Transgenic rice mein beta-carotene (vitamin A ka pehla madda) banane ke genes kahan se liye gaye?)
blocks.explanation: Beta-carotene ke genes daffodil se liye gaye; iron ke genes beans, Aspergillus fungus aur wild rice se (20.4.3).

book_ref.quote: the genes for making beta-carotene (a precursor of vitamin A) were taken from daffodil

blocks.prompt:
70 According to the chapter, deficiency of vitamin A each year kills:
(Chapter ke mutabiq vitamin A ki kami har saal kitne bachon ki jaan leti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har saal vitamin A ki kami 670,000 bachon ki jaan leti aur 500,000 bachon mein na-qabil-e-ilaj andhapan paida karti hai; iron ki kami 1.4 billion auraton ko mutasir karti hai (20.4.3).

book_ref.quote: deficiency of vitamin A kills 670,000 children

blocks.prompt:
71 GMO plants and plant cells are used for the production of biopharmaceuticals such as:
(GMO paude aur plant cells kin biopharmaceuticals ki tayyari mein istemal hote hain?)

options.text: cytokines, hormones, antibodies, enzymes aur vaccines

blocks.explanation: GMO paude aur plant cells cytokines, hormones, antibodies, enzymes aur vaccines jaise biopharmaceuticals banate hain (20.4.3).

book_ref.quote: GMO plants and plant cells are used for the production of biopharmaceuticals

blocks.text: 20.5 Formation of human insulin in bacteria

blocks.prompt:
72 The first major triumph of genetic engineers was the production of:
(Genetic engineers ki pehli bari kamyabi kis cheez ki tayyari thi?)
blocks.explanation: Human insulin ki tayyari genetic engineers ki pehli bari kamyabi thi (20.5).

book_ref.quote: The production of human insulin was the first major triumph of genetic engineers.

blocks.prompt:
73 Synthetic human insulin is made by:
(Synthetic human insulin kaise banti hai?)

options.text: gaye ke pancreas se nikaal kar
do polypeptide chains alag bana kar kimiyai taur par jod kar
aik culture mein aik hi chain bana kar

blocks.explanation: Do polypeptide chains alag alag banti hain aur phir kimiyai taur par jodi jati hain (20.5).

book_ref.quote: involves producing the two polypeptide chains separately and then joining them chemically

blocks.prompt:
74 In making human insulin, the insulin gene is often attached next to a bacterial gene such as lacZ to:
(Human insulin banate waqt insulin gene ko aksar lacZ jaise bacterial gene ke saath kyun joda jata hai?)

options.text: bacteria ghair DNA ko pehchan kar express karein
chain A ko chain B se jode
expression ke baad bacteria maar de

blocks.explanation: lacZ jaise bacterial gene ke saath jodne se bacteria ghair DNA ko 'pehchan' kar express karte hain (20.5).

book_ref.quote: the insulin gene is often attached next to a bacterial gene (like lacZ)

blocks.prompt:
75 In insulin production, the recombinant plasmids for chain A and chain B are introduced into:
(Insulin ki tayyari mein chain A aur chain B ke recombinant plasmids kahan dale jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Plasmids do alag cultures mein dale jaate hain: culture 1 chain A banati hai, culture 2 chain B (20.5).

book_ref.quote: The recombinant plasmids are introduced into two separate cultures of Escherichia coli bacteria.

blocks.prompt:
76 In the fermentation and protein expression step of insulin production, bacteria are grown in:
(Insulin ki tayyari ke fermentation aur protein expression qadam mein bacteria kahan ugaye jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria bare industrial bioreactors mein ugaye jaate hain jahan woh insani DNA 'parh' kar insulin chains banate hain (20.5).

book_ref.quote: The bacteria are grown in large industrial bioreactors.

blocks.prompt:
77 Chain A and chain B of insulin are linked in the laboratory by:
(Insulin ki chain A aur chain B lab mein kis cheez se jodi jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chain A aur B milayi jati hain aur makhsoos amino acids ke darmiyan disulfide bonds (sulfur-sulfur pul) se jurti hain (20.5).

book_ref.quote: They are linked by creating di-sulfide bonds (sulfur-to-sulfur bridges) between specific amino acids.
